text:
Lina: Heads-up: GreenHarbor submitted their privacy & vendor questionnaire. Main asks: EU residency for embeddings, full subprocessor roster + contracts, retention windows (they request 180d), and whether we can provide per-tenant export/delete proofs. They want answers within 6 business days. PDF attached in ticket.

Marco: can someone grab the exact snippets they highlighted? will triage.

Devon: pasted highlights from their form:
- Are embeddings and derived data stored in EU-only regions and can we enforce tenant-level residency?
- Provide complete subprocessor list and example DPA clauses we have with them.
- Can embeddings retention be set to 180 days and can you provide deletion/export evidence?
- Confirm SOC2 coverage for the EU infra and monitoring vendors.

Priya: Security take. Short answers: 1) Hosted tenants default to region-aware routing; we can pin residency for enterprise tenants via config + contract but need EngOps to confirm timeline. 2) Will post subprocessor list + recent contracts redactions. 3) Deletion proofs: we can provide deletion job logs and object-store lifecycle records; ops needs to surface examples.

Jared: Legal: I'll prepare tailored DPA language for subprocessor transparency + deletion SLA. Also we should outline the residency gating terms (contractual & implementation timing). ETA for draft: 72 hours after security artifacts are posted.

Marco: Ops note: residency enforcement requires a migration to EU-backed tenancy for persistent residency guarantees. We can provide a soft residency (request routing) immediately but full enforcement (no cross-region spill) needs a tenant move. Estimated lead time: 3-4 weeks.

Lina: Important: they flagged renewal on 2026-05-12 and want answers by 2026-05-06. This is a potential blocker.

Priya: Action items (security): 1) Produce redacted subprocessor spreadsheet + SOC2 links 2) Provide sample rotation logs & key provenance for KMS where applicable 3) Work with Ops to capture deletion/export job samples. I'll post links when ready.

Devon: ops artifact for deletion proof (redacted): https://internal.ops/evidence/greenharbor/deletion-job-logs-2026.zip

Marco: residency options memo draft:
- Option A: Soft routing (same-day) -> routes traffic to EU region but no strict guarantee; low effort.
- Option B: Tenant relocation to EU cluster -> 3-4 week schedule, requires maintenance window and a migration plan.
- Option C: Private/Dedicated deployment in EU -> procurement and pricing; best residency and BYOK.

Jared: If customer requires contractual guarantee of residency for renewal, Sales must be looped for commitment to migration/Private. Marking renewal_risk = high until we have a firm path.

Lina: I'll attach onboarding vendor list and the customer's completed form here -> https://drive.internal/greenharbor/questionnaire_2026-04.pdf (attached).

Compliance Bot: Document uploaded to evidence repo: /evidence/greenharbor/2026-04-questionnaire.pdf  sha256: d9f7... (automated).

Priya: Preliminary uploads: subprocessor list (redacted) -> https://internal/security/subprocessors/redacted-subprocessors-2026.csv; SOC2 links posted to the shared drive.

Jared: I'll draft DPA addendum offering two retention choices (90d default, 180d opt-in) and explicit deletion/export evidence clause. Posting draft by Tue EOD.

Marco: Ops will prepare migration checklist and estimated downtime window.

Lina: Great. Next steps: Priya + Marco to post artifacts by Mon EOD, Jared drafts DPA by Tue, Lina to coordinate customer call Wed. If they insist on contractual residency guarantee for hosted, escalate to Sales.

Devon: flagged as renewal risk: high. Adding account exec once DPA draft is ready.

Jared: quick question for CSMs - do they accept an initial 90d while migration is planned for 180d? Lina, can you confirm on the call?

Lina: will confirm during the sync. Also capture feedback on docs — they said residency & retention docs were tricky.

Compliance Bot: Reminder set: internal signoff check 2026-05-05 09:00 UTC.
